notes: The SYNTHETIC brand set for the NoaCG Pro BRAND round (docs/NOACG_PRO_PLAN.md §14 item 0). Four invented organisations, deliberately far apart - a heavy sport wordmark, a quiet institutional monogram, a bright consumer roundel, a monochrome editorial mark - so brand-driven divergence is measurable rather than hoped for. Owner's choice: invented brands, never real ones, so no third party's marks are used. Each mark is an SVG beside this file with explicit width/height; its shape, backing and ink are MEASURED at run time by assets/assetInfo.ts probeMark (the content-free contract Lite uses) - never hand-written here. `typeface` is a src/model/fonts.ts id; the runner passes its verbatim @font-face to the model. `assignment` fixes which brand conditions each brief in the main 12x2 grid, so a round is reproducible from committed fixtures alone; `divergence` names the same-brief/different-brand cell run on top of it.

divergence.notes: Same brief, every OTHER brand, on the no-exemplar arm only - the assigned brand's none-arm generation already exists in the main grid, so each divergence brief yields a full 4-brand row for the price of 3 extra generations. Two briefs from opposite worlds, so divergence is read where the brief itself pulls hardest and where it pulls least.
